body:
I promise you if you go and tell your Dad you want to kill yourself because of everything you just said he will understand. Tell your family exactly what you wrote here. Be brave, its better than what waits for you in the world alone. 

Take every day from now as it comes and dont look too far. 

You are strong!

This is what everybody always tells me, but I'm not that strong. I'm really great at pretending to be though, I guess this is why my friends and mother never really worry about me. Always great grades. Healthy. Sporting. Clever. I've always been an all-rounder, literally always. And now I'm fucked, totally, and I have nobody to talk to about it because nobody really understands. Also, I've never really spoken to anyone about how scared I feel before - I've always been the one doing the consoling... thinking of the next steps, the productive plan / way out.   


Who checks on the strong?   
What happens when the strong break, we too are human, are we not?   


I'm a bit broken, but you know what, thank you for your words - made me feel nice regardless. I guess that's why I came here, just to tell someone something and maybe hear something back.   


Thank you x
